body.name: \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}\)
body.def: For an identity-homotopic torus optimal-transport diffeomorphism, choose the unique \(\mathbb Z^2\)-equivariant representation \(\widetilde F(x)=x+a_F+\nabla\phi_F(x)\) with \(a_F\in\mathcal Q\) and \(\int_{\mathbb T^2}\phi_F=0\); outside this regular domain use the fixed Borel fallback \((a_F,\phi_F,\widetilde F)=(0,0,\operatorname{id})\).
